acceptedAnswer.text: Father of Insane™ and Warflex™ are two products that are formulated to be consumed pre-workout. Pick which product aligns with your goals for that training session and your personal stimulant tolerance, and adhere to the instructions on the product label.

acceptedAnswer.text: Some Promolecules™ products have a high stimulant content and may, in fact, be inappropriate for a beginner. Read the product label and start the product regimen only if you have sufficient tolerance and experience.
